_readme: Real-package smoke corpus. Specs are exactly pinned (name@version). Expectations were hand-verified by running `MODSYM_CACHE=$(mktemp -d) node bin/modsym.js <spec> <symbol>` with a fresh cache and recording the true current output. scripts/real-corpus.mjs re-runs each case against the network and asserts status, reason, and (when resolved) the exact declaration file and kind. A different resolved file/kind is a hard failure. Never edit expectations to make the runner pass; investigate behavior changes first.

cases.note: Same-file alias in root dist/index.d.ts (method ts-ast-same-file-alias).
Untyped package; documented abstention example from README.
Typed package that still abstains: the root declaration entry re-exports transpileModule via a form modsym v0.1 does not traverse. Truthful abstention, recorded exactly as observed.
Untyped micro-package; verified no_types rather than assumed.
Intentional abstention case: export-graph walk cannot be shown complete, so modsym abstains instead of guessing.
